title: The relative-write clause is skipped only after an outside-home cd
ruling: Lane ruling 2026-11-08 11:23 CST, under coordinator grant 10:43 CST: the relative-write clause is skipped for a segment only when (a) the last absolute or ~ cd landed outside the home and (b) the folder the segment runs in is outside the home. A variable cd, bare cd, cd -, popd or unknown folder reset (a). An absolute cd into the home is still judged.
quote: lane ruling 11:23 CST (Nov 8), under coordinator grant 10:43 CST
source: PR #2197 body; its only home was #2197's edit of docs/decisions/an-agent-outside-its-home-tree-must-stop.md. Lane guard-relative-write-escape writes the sentence into that file in its PR, which is its home on main when merged. Filed by triage.
